title: Imaging Unit Error
shortDescription: The imaging unit reports an operational fault.
fullDescription:
Lexmark code 500.00 describes an imaging unit (photoconductor) condition. The imaging unit reports an operational fault. Print quality may be degraded and the unit should be inspected or replaced.

Reseating the imaging unit, cleaning its contacts, and verifying firmware are first steps. A replacement imaging kit is the usual resolution when the component is at end of life.

title: Firmware Panic
shortDescription: The printer firmware encountered a panic and rebooted.
fullDescription:
Lexmark code 925.00 indicates a firmware-level issue. The printer firmware encountered a panic and rebooted. A restart or firmware reflash often resolves the condition.

If the error recurs, export settings, reflash firmware, and reset NVRAM. Contact support for persistent cases.

fullDescription:
Lexmark error 70 indicates a problem with the print server or wireless adapter. The network interface reports an error.

Power cycle, check cables (for wired), verify SSID and credentials (for wireless), and update firmware. Replace the wireless card or controller if faults persist.

title: Transfer Belt Error
shortDescription: The transfer belt is faulty or missing.
fullDescription:
Lexmark code 550 indicates a fault with the transfer belt, which moves toner from imaging units to paper. The belt may be missing, misinstalled, or at end of life.

Reseating the belt, inspecting contacts, and replacing when worn are standard steps.

Check for transport lock engaged, reseat ribbon cables (service), and power cycle.
